referenceTitle: Category-Specific Maximum Levels for Cadmium and Lead in Edible Offal
reason: The bibliography supplies a generic description, without a jurisdiction, issuing body, instrument number, date or link. No uniquely identifiable original source was recovered. EU 2023/915 contains relevant tissue-specific limits, but it cannot silently stand in for the unidentified citation.

review.reviewer: Codex: unresolved identity after bibliography and exact-title search

evidence.note: Read relevant current EU lead and cadmium entries as separately named context for refs 1 and 5. This does not establish that EU 2023/915 was the intended source. Lead limits are not universally higher for offal: poultry offal and muscle both have 0.10 mg/kg wet-weight maxima.
